title: Expanded KPI tables show the expected columns
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as a user whose role has the Reports permission, for example an Administrator. To check a role: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > the Reports permission is switched on.
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. In the top bar, use the workplace selector at the top left (it shows the workplace name, e.g. "ShopHub") to pick a workplace that has invoices and technician clocked time on several different days this month and in the last twelve months (on the QA environment the "QA Testing" data has this).
custom_steps:
1. Open the dashboard and set Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization to Last 12 Months.
  2. Click View details on Billing Efficiency and read the table title and column headings.
  3. Click View details on Technician Efficiency and read the table title, column headings and the pager under the table.
  4. Click View details on Technician Utilization and read the table title and column headings.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Billing Efficiency: a table titled "Advisor Analysis" under the chart, with columns Advisor, Worked Hours, Invoiced Hrs, Billing Efficiency, ELR.
  • Technician Efficiency: a table titled "Technician Efficiency" with columns Tech, Clocked Hrs, Invoiced Tech Hrs, Efficiency. It shows ten rows a page with a pager such as "1 - 10 of 13".
  • Technician Utilization: a table titled "Technician Utilization" with columns Tech, WO Hours, Internal Hours, Total Hours, Utilization %.
  • Each table sits in the one full-width panel under the top row, below its chart.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 6 (S6-R4 to S6-R6). Column names and the pager come from the design canvas boards 05_Billing_After, 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After (rows 5 to 7, screenshots of build SV-8311 captured 2026-09-28), which replace the retired 'Dashboard Directions' design.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R4: “The Billing Efficiency tile expands to the Billing Efficiency chart and the Advisor Analysis table.”
  • S6-R5: “The Technician Efficiency tile expands to the Technician Efficiency chart and the Technician Efficiency table.”
  • S6-R6: “The Technician Utilization tile expands to the Technician Utilization chart and the Technician Utilization table.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
